subject: Pre-audit interview & evidence sampling plan - Cypress Financial
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@cypressfin.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-audit interview & evidence sampling plan - Cypress Financial

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call on Friday. We're kicking off a short pre-audit coordination sprint to lock interview slots and evidence sampling windows ahead of the formal assessment. Attached: evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx (initial mapping).

Quick asks:
- Can your audit team confirm preferred interview days the week of Aug 23–27? We can accommodate mornings (PDT) or early afternoons.
- For evidence sampling, please confirm which systems you want primary artifacts from (S3 access logs, KMS key rotation records, auth logs for the period May 1–Jul 31).
- Is NorthStar able to share a 30–45 minute interview agenda per function (infra, app, identity)? If so we can pre-select SMEs.

I'll assign owners internally once we have your preferred slots. Marcus will own infra logs, Irene will coordinate artifact pulls, and Aditya will manage the control mapping questions.

Attachments: evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@cypressfin.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Brown <emma.brown@northstar-audit.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-audit interview & evidence sampling plan - Cypress Financial

Jasmine —

Thanks, this is helpful. NorthStar (cc'd) prefers Aug 24–25 for interviews; morning slots are best (09:00–12:00 PDT). Emma — would you like to block 45-minute windows per function (infra / platform / identity)?

Regarding evidence, please prioritize the following for sampling:
- S3 server access logs (buckets: prod-logs, app-uploads) for May 1–Jul 31
- KMS key rotation history for customer-key alias/primary keys used in prod
- Auth logs (successful + failed) for the platform auth service (auth.redwoodinference.com) for the same date range

If you can provide a single zipped sample (one day per system) that will be enough for initial review — larger pulls can follow after scope confirmation.

Sam Walters
Director, Third-Party Risk
Cypress Financial
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Walters <sam.walters@cypressfin.com>

> Thanks, this is helpful. NorthStar (cc'd) prefers Aug 24–25 for interviews; morning slots are best (09:00–12:00 PDT).

Agree — we'll hold mornings on Aug 24 and 25 as tentative. Confirmed internal owners: Marcus (infra logs), Irene (artifact extraction), me (control mapping and tracker).

Action items from our side:
- Marcus to upload one-day S3 access log samples (prod-logs, app-uploads) to shared Drive by Aug 17.
- Irene to produce KMS rotation CSV and list of key aliases by Aug 17.
- I'll assemble a short user access matrix and MFA evidence (screenshots) by Aug 18.

We'll post artifacts to the Drive folder (link below) and set ACLs for Emma + Sam.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_evidence

Aditya Rao
Head of Platform Security
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-audit interview & evidence sampling plan - Cypress Financial

Sam / team —

Quick technical notes to avoid back-and-forth during the audit:
- S3 logs: location s3://prod-logs/server-access/2027-05-01.log and s3://app-uploads/access/2027-05-01.log. We will provide gzip'd copies (one day) for May 1, Jun 15, Jul 10 as representative samples.
- KMS: rotation events are in CloudTrail under kms:RotateKey; I'll export the rotation history CSV for aliases: alias/redwood-prod-key and alias/customer-data-key.
- Auth logs: aggregated in ELK as auth-service-logs-YYYY.MM.DD; will export the 2027-06-15 index slice as JSONL.

I'll attach a short control_interview_questions.pdf with suggested prompts for the infra and identity interviews. That should speed the interviews and reduce clarification requests.

Irene Choi
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Brown <emma.brown@northstar-audit.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Walters <sam.walters@cypressfin.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-audit interview & evidence sampling plan - Cypress Financial

Thanks, team —

Aug 24 morning slots work. Please block 09:00–10:00 for infra, 10:30–11:15 for identity, and 11:30–12:00 for platform (shorter). Attached is a 45-minute interview agenda and a checklist of preliminary artifacts we need before the session.

Preliminary checklist highlights:
- One-day samples for S3 access logs (see Irene's paths)
- KMS rotation CSV with timestamps and principal IDs
- User access matrix (username, role, last activity) for prod systems
- MFA screenshots or an export showing last 90-day MFA enforcement policy changes

If you can upload the artifacts to the Drive folder by Aug 17–18 and grant Emma + Sam access, we'll do a light validation and then confirm final interview invites.

Attachment: pre-audit-agenda.docx

Best,
Emma Brown
Senior Auditor
NorthStar Audit
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@cypressfin.com>, Emma Brown <emma.brown@northstar-audit.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-audit interview & evidence sampling plan - Cypress Financial

All —

Confirmed plan and next steps:
- Aug 17: Marcus and Irene to upload S3, KMS, and auth samples to Drive (link below).
- Aug 18: Aditya to upload user access matrix and MFA evidence.
- Aug 24 (09:00–12:00 PDT): NorthStar interviews (infra / identity / platform) — invites to follow.
- Owners: Marcus (infra logs), Irene (artifact exports), Aditya (access matrix + control mapping), Jasmine (coordination / DocuSign & evidence tracker).

I'll raise JIRA-SEC-874 to track outstanding asks and will send a DocuSign (DOCU12345) for access confirmation delegation from Cypress. If anything changes to the artifact list please flag by EOD Aug 16.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_evidence

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth pre-audit run.

Jasmine Liu
Sr. Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
